user.title: Domyos Rower
user.description: Pull the handle to wake the rower and enable its Bluetooth, then pick it.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

abort.no_devices_found: No Domyos rower found. Wake it up (pull the handle) and make sure a Bluetooth adapter or proxy is in range.

upload_garmin.name: Send the last session to Garmin Connect

init.title: Session export
init.description: Folder where the FIT, TCX and GPX files are written. GPX is a GPS format: an indoor session has no position, so every point uses the coordinates below (your Home Assistant home by default).

data.setup_garmin: Link (or re-link) my Garmin Connect account

garmin.title: Garmin Connect account
garmin.description: The Garmin upload uses an **unofficial** sign-in (garminconnect library): it can stop working when Garmin changes its login. Your password is used once to open the session; only the e-mail and the session token are kept.

garmin_mfa.title: Two-step verification
garmin_mfa.description: Garmin sent you a verification code (e-mail or app). Enter it.

error.garmin_auth_failed: Garmin refused the e-mail or the password.
error.garmin_cannot_connect: Cannot reach Garmin (network, attempt limit, or library installation).
